items.t: CVT damage when the fluid gets low
items.job: Replace CVT assembly and fluid
items.note: Fixing a leak early costs far less. Check the powertrain warranty (5 years/60,000 miles).

items.t: Sudden loss of drive or reduced propulsion
items.job: Replace transmission valve body and reprogram
items.note: Usually covered under the powertrain warranty when the vehicle is within it.

items.t: Shift to Park message and no start
items.job: Replace shifter assembly

items.t: Oil leak from a porous cylinder head
items.job: Repair porous cylinder head area per GM bulletin

items.t: Turbo wastegate rattle and low boost
items.job: Replace wastegate regulator valve or turbocharger
items.note: The valve alone is the low end; a full turbo is the high end.

items.t: Power loss in extreme cold
items.job: Apply GM cold-weather bulletin (software and ventilation updates)

items.t: EVAP purge pump failure
items.job: Replace EVAP purge pump
items.note: May be free under GM special coverage; check your VIN.

items.t: Roof leak causing electrical problems
items.job: Reseal roof joint and dry interior

items.t: Oil pressure warning code won't clear
items.job: Engine computer software update (emissions recall)

items.t: Lane keep and safety alerts act up
items.job: Front camera calibration or software update

items.t: Front brake squeal
items.job: Replace front brake pads

items.t: Service power steering message
items.job: Diagnose and repair steering angle sensor fault

items.t: Loose cylinder head bolts
items.job: Check and tighten cylinder head bolts (dealer campaign)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if your VIN is included.

items.t: Engine sputters, stalls or runs rough
items.job: Diagnose and replace failed ignition or fuel part, or update software

items.t: Cruise control won't set after braking
items.job: Replace brake pedal assembly or switch

items.t: AWD service message
items.job: Diagnose AWD and repair rear drive motor or wiring
items.note: Wide range; a wiring fix is cheap, a rear drive part is not.

items.t: Auto stop/start stops working
items.job: Repair auxiliary transmission pump circuit or replace pump

items.t: Loss of brake assist (recall)
items.job: Replace electronic brake boost module
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Front seat bolts may be missing (recall)
items.job: Install front seat bolts
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Emergency jack can break (recall)
items.job: Replace emergency jack
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
items.job: Instrument cluster software update
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Backup camera image blank or distorted (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear camera
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.
